basics.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | React, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, AWS & AI Systems

summaries.default: Example profile. Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications, internal platforms, and AI-integrated workflows across React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

variants.fullstack: Example profile. Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience owning end-to-end product architecture across React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, and FastAPI on AWS and Kubernetes.
variants.ai_platform: Example profile. Senior Full-Stack & AI Platform Engineer with 5+ years of experience building LLM-powered workflows and asynchronous Python/FastAPI pipelines (Celery/SQS) on AWS and Kubernetes.
variants.frontend: Example profile. Senior Frontend & Full-Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, and Design Systems.

work_authorization.india: Authorized to work for any employer

bullets.text: Built an internal asset-management platform with a React/TypeScript frontend and a FastAPI/Python backend using asynchronous Celery/SQS workflows.
bullets.impact_metric: End-to-end platform architecture with async job orchestration

bullets.text: Built a localisation dashboard and integrated Gemini LLMs to score translation quality automatically, with alerting on regressions.
bullets.impact_metric: Automated LLM quality evaluation for localised content

bullets.text: Engineered an FFmpeg-based media pipeline for video, GIF, and audio rendering, fixing edge cases in sample rates and browser streaming.
Added content signatures for deduplication and idempotent retries to prevent duplicate records during transient AWS/database failures.
Migrated a marketing website to Next.js and Strapi CMS, parallelising data fetches and fixing hydration mismatches to reduce page load times by 45%.
Built reusable UI packages for a design system in Figma and React/Storybook, cutting frontend cycle times by 40%.
Set up a finance monorepo across React and FastAPI with REST integrations to an accounting system (NetSuite).
Provisioned Terraform infrastructure (ECR, RDS, S3, IAM) and Helm charts with KEDA queue-based autoscaling for background workers.
Built SEO-optimised landing pages in React, increasing organic traffic by 40%.
Fixed client-facing UI/UX defects and shipped fast stakeholder feedback loops.
Built a custom CMS and a macOS desktop app with Electron.js and Vue.js, halving content publishing time.
Designed MongoDB schemas and provisioned AWS infrastructure for faster data retrieval.
Led Vue.js frontend delivery tracks with consistent on-time milestones.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology - Computer Science Engineering

screening_qa_bank.question_pattern: why do you want to join|why this company|why are you interested
screening_qa_bank.answer_guideline: Connect 5+ years of end-to-end ownership across React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI and AWS with the product and engineering challenges in the JD. Keep under 3 concise sentences.

screening_qa_bank.question_pattern: notice period|how soon can you join|earliest start date
screening_qa_bank.answer_guideline: State the notice_period_days from application_defaults and mention willingness to discuss early release if applicable.
Use current_ctc_lpa and expected_ctc_lpa from application_defaults in INR LPA, noting openness to competitive market compensation.
Highlight LLM integration work from the experience section (e.g. automated translation quality scoring).
